facts.text: Appointed Personnel Officer for St. Lawrence County in July 2025 after more than a decade in county Human Resources, previously serving as a Human Resource Technician
facts.source: New York State Association of Personnel and Civil Service Officers

facts.text: Earned an associate's degree in Professional Communication from SUNY Onondaga Community College and a bachelor's degree in Political Science from SUNY Plattsburgh, and earned SHRM-CP certification
facts.source: New York State Association of Personnel and Civil Service Officers

facts.text: Earned New York State DCJS State Instructor Certification through SUNY Potsdam's Law Enforcement Training Institute Instructor Development Course, as a SUNY Potsdam University Police officer
Community Engagement Coordinator at GardenShare in Canton, New York; came to St. Lawrence County to attend SUNY Potsdam
Quoted for New Testament Church in Massena in 2020 on distributing 3,276 USDA Farmers to Families food boxes to the community, reaching over 800 households
Facing the first contested re-election of his State Senate career in 2026, running against Democratic newcomer Cassie Robbins-Forbus for the 49th District seat in the November 3, 2026 election
Senior Sales Director at Precise Biometrics; quoted in 2021 on Precise's YOUNiQ facial-recognition access agreement with Clarkson University's North Country Incubator in Potsdam
Named to SUNY Canton's President's List for the fall 2021 semester as a Legal Studies student
